release_notes_summary: Stable 0.9.13 adds Standard Searle and updates Super Pedestrian results presentation.
notes: Adds the Standard Searle workflow using the canonical Searle Classic calculation routine. The workflow accepts an explicit carry, including zero, and the collision angle; a missing required angle or carry is reported as insufficient input.
Adds the Standard Searle workflow to the calculator registry and results flow while preserving the existing Searle Classic calculation.
Super Pedestrian Results presents the method rows in a vertically scrollable results area and clarifies excluded-method wording.
Existing unit conversions and assumptions are carried through the Standard Searle workflow. No change was made to the canonical Searle Classic calculation.
The package retains the approved set of 22 public reference documents with exact bytes; internal-only documents remain excluded.
Source regression checks passed for the approved Standard Searle workflow and Super Pedestrian presentation changes.

This candidate was built from the verified 0.9.12 source snapshot plus the approved four application files and stable release metadata. Frozen-module comparison is recorded in the candidate verification receipt.
Packaged startup, calculator input/result behavior, updater discovery, local deployment and anonymous public asset checks are recorded in the release evidence.
